name: ProteinWorkshop
description: We introduce ProteinWorkshop, a comprehensive benchmark suite for representation learning on protein structures with Geometric Graph Neural Networks. We consider large-scale pre-training and downstream tasks on both experimental and predicted structures to enable the systematic evaluation of the quality of the learned structural representation and their usefulness in capturing functional relationships for downstream tasks. We find that: (1) large-scale pretraining on AlphaFold structures and auxiliary tasks consistently improve the performance of both rotation-invariant and equivariant GNNs, and (2) more expressive equivariant GNNs benefit from pretraining to a greater extent compared to invariant models. We aim to establish a common ground for the machine learning and computational biology communities to rigorously compare and advance protein structure representation learning. reputation: A recent open benchmark suite for protein structure representation learning that is gaining attention in computational biology and geometric deep learning.
notes: Benchmark suite spans multiple tasks and metrics, so scores are not directly comparable across tasks; results depend heavily on pretraining data and model architecture.
